### 1 — Scene
A mixed vegetarian meal: tofu with vegetable slaw, cooked quinoa, leafy greens, and vegetable-topped flatbread/pizza. The orange-topped item is somewhat uncertain.

### 2 — Vessel
A large square dinner plate, estimated **26 cm per side**. Its area is approximately **676 cm²**, equivalent to a round plate 29.3 cm in diameter:  
3.14 × (29.3 ÷ 2)² ≈ 674 cm².

### 3 — Items
- Seasoned tofu strips
- Shredded cabbage/vegetable slaw, including radish, tomato and cauliflower
- Cooked quinoa with vegetables
- Orange-sauce flatbread/pizza with tomato, red onion and green vegetable toppings
- Leafy greens, mostly spinach

No separate pool of dressing or oil is clearly visible. Any preparation fat is included in the estimated energy densities.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy
Area shares represent non-overlapping portions of the plate; toppings are included with their underlying item.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Tofu | 14% | 95 cm² × 1.5 cm = 142 ml | 0.95 | 135 g | 145 | 196 kcal |
| Vegetable slaw | 16% | 108 cm² × 1.5 cm = 162 ml | 0.55 | 89 g | 55 | 49 kcal |
| Quinoa with vegetables | 12% | 81 cm² × 2 cm = 162 ml | 0.8 | 130 g | 135 | 176 kcal |
| Vegetable flatbread/pizza | 30% | 203 cm² × 0.85 cm = 172 ml | 0.95 | 164 g | 240 | 394 kcal |
| Leafy greens | 23% | 155 cm² × 3 cm = 466 ml | 0.12 | 56 g | 25 | 14 kcal |
| **Total** | **95%** | | | **574 g** | | **829 kcal** |

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **575 g and 830 kcal** is plausible for this nearly full plate. The leafy pile contributes relatively little weight; most energy comes from the flatbread, tofu and quinoa. The flatbread identification and its preparation are the largest uncertainties.
